2. This second present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in S. T. No. 315 of 2018, arising out case crime No. 319 of 2018, under Sections-498A, 304B IPC and Sections-3 / 4 of D. P. Act, police station Line Bazar, District Jaunpur, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

First bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 5.9.2022 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 1272 of 2020.

sentences.text: It was stated that the deceased has committed suicide on 19.6.2018 by putting herself at fire.

Referring to the statement of the Tehsildar, who has conducted the inquest proceedings, it was pointed out that the room where the incident took place, was found locked from inside and dead body of deceased was taken out by breaking the door.
This fact goes to show that the deceased has committed suicide by burning herself.
At the time of incident the applicant was in Rajasthan, where he used to work.
The allegation of dowry demand and harassment of deceased levelled against the accused persons, including the applicant, are wholly false.
In the first information report merely a vague allegation has been made that deceased was being harassed on account of dowry.
There is no such specific allegation that what was being demanded in dowry.

It is further submitted that the first bail application of applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 5.9.2022 and trial Court was directed to decide the case expeditiously according to the provisions of Section 309 CrPC but trial has not been concluded so far, whereas the applicant is in jail since 2.7.2018 and thus, he has already undergone the detention of five years and ten months.

The material witnesses have been examined but the case is still at the stage of prosecution evidence,
thus, trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
It was submitted that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is husband of deceased, who has suffered death due to burn injuries within seven years of her marriage.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Chandan Nishad involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
I. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
Iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.
Order Date:- 31.5.2024
